rationale: B renders a more convincing, material-rich product object and turns the sound technology into scroll-linked storytelling: the speaker explodes into labelled layers (tweeters, sideways bass, five parts), followed by a horizontally travelling materials gallery and an oversized 'Halo' wordmark finale. A is also polished, with a staggered headline-then-object entrance, a scroll-linked text reveal and a speaker that zooms into the glowing ring and knit. But its object reads as a flatter CSS cylinder, and on mobile its persistent 'Pause motion / Replay intro' pill sits over body copy. A's hover states are bolder: the buttons invert to a cream fill. B's are subtler glows and underlines, and B's mobile has one long empty dark gap between sections, but B still feels more award-level overall.
